artifactsDefect.mechanism: pdf-lib's form.flatten() deletes the widget annotation objects and leaves their references in each page's /Annots; buildPacket's copyPages then reserves a fresh object number for each unresolvable reference and never emits an object at it. One fault, two faces: 954 - 808 = 146 = the dangling count, because each dangling reference consumes exactly one reserved-and-never-written number.
artifactsDefect.repair: The prune runs on each component document immediately after flatten and BEFORE copyPages, from the single shared implementation at scripts/lib/pdf-prune-dangling-annots.mjs, which this builder imports rather than copies. A second prune guards the merged packet and the build asserts zero unresolvable /Annots references on the reopened delivered bytes.
artifactsDefect.verifiersProposedXrefPassEvaluatedAndNot: The verifiers also proposed emitting an xref covering 0..Size-1 with unused numbers marked free. Not adopted, because pruning before the copy makes it unnecessary rather than merely redundant: with nothing dangling to copy, pdf-lib's /Size falls to the true largest object number and its writer emits a single full-coverage subsection unaided. Measured after repair: /Size 808 over 808 covered in 1 subsection, the same shape as the already-clean il-exp-pardon-set and il-seal-edu-set. A hand-written xref downstream of pdf-lib's writer would have masked the cause rather than removed it.
